title: NavigationRequest
description: Schema for an indoor route calculation request in MapLess AI

buildingId.description: Unique identifier of the building where navigation occurs

startNodeId.description: Origin node ID (manually selected by visitor in V1)

accessible.description: Requires wheelchair-accessible paths only (avoid stairs/steep slopes)

avoidStairs.description: Prefers elevators or ramps over staircases

emergencyMode.description: Routes toward nearest verified emergency exits
